title: Layer 5: Wild Signals
title_zh: 第五层：草蛇灰线——意外信号
desc: Grassroots clues — more reliable than headlines
desc_zh: 这些不在头条里，但比任何高级指标都准

mbsItinerary.value: Beijing Apr 2026. Stayed in Saudi during Hormuz crisis. Next: ?
mbsItinerary.value_zh: 2026年4月访京。霍尔木兹危机期间留守沙特。下一站：？
mbsItinerary.threshold: More Beijing than DC visits = strategic drift
mbsItinerary.threshold_zh: 去北京多于华盛顿=战略偏移
mbsItinerary.note: MBS has not traveled abroad since Hormuz crisis escalation. Stayed in Saudi; no new foreign trip reported. MBS called Trump as Islamabad talks started without Riyadh (houseofsaud, Jul 11). Saudi FM concluded China visit amid Trump-MBS tensions (Crypto Briefing, Jul 1) — 'Riyadh Pledged the Billion — Beijing Got the Visit'. US-Saudi nuclear deal security implications under scrutiny (Al Jazeera, Jul 23). Saudi military now directly engaged — strikes Houthi Hodeidah, Houthis fire at Saudi oil facilities, US-Saudi joint strikes on Iraqi bases. MBS continues to chair Cabinet in Riyadh. Updated 2026-08-02
mbsItinerary.note_zh: MBS留守沙特，未出访。霍尔木兹危机升级后无新外国行程。伊斯兰堡谈判开始而利雅得缺席时，MBS致电特朗普（houseofsaud，7月11日）。沙特外交大臣在特朗普-MBS紧张中结束访华（Crypto Briefing，7月1日）——'利雅得承诺数十亿——北京得到了访问'。美沙核协议安全影响受审视（半岛电视台，7月23日）。沙特军方直接参战——打击胡塞荷台达，胡塞袭击沙特石油设施，美沙联合打击伊拉克基地。MBS继续在利雅得主持内阁。更新于 2026-08-02

singaporeStance.value: Officially neutral, adjusting quietly — AI hub role growing
singaporeStance.value_zh: 官方中立，暗中调整——AI枢纽角色增长
singaporeStance.threshold: Singapore picks a side = every other Asian ally is already doing it
singaporeStance.threshold_zh: 新加坡选边=其他亚洲盟友已经在做了
singaporeStance.note: Both US and Chinese AI firms setting up shop in Singapore as 'Asia's neutral AI hub' (Fortune, Jun 19). No policy stance shift yet. Singapore maintains neutral posture as US-Iran war escalates across region (Kuwait base attacked, Gulf energy infrastructure hit). Singapore may benefit as safe haven for Gulf capital flight; HKD-adjacent flows stable. No new Singapore policy signals this cycle. Updated 2026-08-02
singaporeStance.note_zh: 中美AI企业均在狮城设点，新加坡为'亚洲中立AI枢纽'（财富，6月19日）。政策立场未变。美伊战争区域升级（科威特基地遭袭、海湾能源设施受打击）中，新加坡保持中立。新加坡可能受益于海湾资本外流的避险资金流入；港币相关资金流稳定。本周期无新加坡新政策信号。更新于 2026-08-02

adbLoanCurrency.threshold: Meaningful increase (>2%) = multilateral acceptance of RMB
adbLoanCurrency.threshold_zh: 显著增长(>2%)=多边机构对RMB的实质接受
adbLoanCurrency.note: ADB annual report still pending. No new ADB data observed this cycle. Record China trade surplus ($125.62B June) strengthens RMB internationalization case. Hormuz re-escalation and oil price surge may accelerate RMB-denominated energy settlement channels (China-Russia, China-Iran). Pakistan-mediated track stalled as conflict resumed. Updated 2026-08-02
adbLoanCurrency.note_zh: 亚行年报仍未发布。本周期无亚行新数据。创纪录中国贸易顺差（6月$1256.2亿）强化人民币国际化论据。霍尔木兹再升级和油价飙升可能加速人民币计价能源结算渠道（中俄、中伊）。巴基斯坦调解轨道随冲突恢复而停滞。更新于 2026-08-02

hkmaInterventions.threshold: Sustained weak-side touches = capital outflow pressure from Asia
hkmaInterventions.threshold_zh: 持续触碰弱方=亚洲资本外流压力
hkmaInterventions.note: No major HKMA intervention reported this cycle. HKD held near weak end without sustained intervention — last major intervention episode was Aug 2025. Gulf capital flight to safe havens possible amid renewed US-Iran escalation (tanker attacks off Oman, Kuwait base hit) but no evidence of sustained weak-side touches yet. Record China surplus supports regional FX stability. Monitor as energy-price shock hits Asia. Updated 2026-08-02
hkmaInterventions.note_zh: 本周未报告金管局重大干预。港币在弱方附近持稳而未持续干预——上次重大干预为2025年8月。美伊再升级（阿曼油轮遇袭、科威特基地遭打击）下海湾资本可能逃向避险资产，但暂无持续弱方兑换触发证据。创纪录中国顺差支持区域汇率稳定。关注能源价格冲击对亚洲的影响。更新于 2026-08-02

chinaGoldImportPath.value: Hong Kong/Dubai route surging; direct Russia unclear
chinaGoldImportPath.value_zh: 香港/迪拜路线激增；对俄直购不明
chinaGoldImportPath.threshold: Route change = settlement system de-dollarization in motion
chinaGoldImportPath.threshold_zh: 路径改变=结算体系去美元化在进行
chinaGoldImportPath.note: China's June net gold imports via Hong Kong up from year ago, down from May (Reuters, Jul 27). Gold price ~$4,100/oz (Jul 31, up from $4,019). Central bank buying remains elevated. World Gold Council: official buying accelerated in May. Hong Kong/Dubai route remains key; direct Russia unclear. Hormuz closure and re-escalation make gold-for-oil settlement mechanisms increasingly relevant. Gold fell 2% Jul 23 on inflation fears/rate-hike bets but recovered on renewed escalation. Updated 2026-08-02
chinaGoldImportPath.note_zh: 中国6月经香港净黄金进口同比上升、较5月下降（路透，7月27日）。金价约$4,100/盎司（7月31日，高于$4,019）。央行购金仍处高位。世界黄金协会：5月官方购买加速。香港/迪拜路线仍关键；对俄直购不明。霍尔木兹关闭和再升级使黄金换石油结算机制愈加相关。金价7月23日因通胀担忧/加息押注跌2%，但在再升级后回升。更新于 2026-08-02

pewFavorability.value_zh: 美国约49% · 中国约36%（2025年，25国中位数）
pewFavorability.threshold: US declining across allies; China stable-low but improving in Global South
pewFavorability.threshold_zh: 美国在盟友中好感度持续下降；中国稳定偏低但在全球南方改善
pewFavorability.note: Pew surveyed 35 countries in 2024 and 25 in spring 2025. US median favorable fell from 54% to ~49%. China rose from 35% to ~36%. No new Pew data published this cycle. Hormuz re-escalation and US military action across region vs China's mediator posture (Pakistan track stalled, but Beijing still seen as non-belligerent) may shift Global South favorability dynamics. Updated 2026-08-02
pewFavorability.note_zh: 皮尤2024年调查35国、2025年春季调查25国。美国好感度中位数从54%降至约49%。中国从35%升至约36%。本周期无新皮尤数据。霍尔木兹再升级和美国在该地区军事行动vs中国非交战调解者姿态（巴基斯坦轨道停滞，但北京仍被视为非交战方）可能改变全球南方好感度动态。更新于 2026-08-02
